A '''turquoise crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The turquoise crystal was a light blue shading to green in color, and had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[natural navigation]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Bersin Sekolah]] possessed a turquoise crystal.<ref name="J15" />
